name: 利尔化学
amount_policy: ratio_only; no holding market value, cost amount, profit amount, or share count
boundary: Stock research dossier input; no portfolio-level buy/sell list and no rebalance action.
data_sources: Tushare: stock_basic, daily, daily_basic, fina_indicator, income, cashflow, balancesheet, moneyflow, fina_mainbz

summary.target_position_range: No target position in this dossier; current about 1.20% ratio is an input for downstream portfolio modules.
summary.one_line_conclusion: 利尔化学 has a real agrochemical business and low valuation percentile after 2025 recovery, but 2026Q1 showed revenue growth with profit decline and negative operating cash flow; Watch only, no add.

basic_info.related_theme: 农化 / 化工周期 / 农药原药和制剂
basic_info.theme_rating: Chemical/agrochemical is not a current A/B tactical mainline; cyclical repair watch only
basic_info.cost_policy: Cost amount is not recorded in this dossier.

position_role.overlap_with_existing_holdings: Belongs to chem/agri/env group with 002041 and 603903; downstream portfolio module should aggregate group risk.

long_term_logic: Main products include pesticide technicals, formulations, intermediates and chemical materials.
2025 revenue and profit recovered strongly from a low base.
Valuation percentile is relatively low across PE, PB and PS since 2024.
current_problems: 2026Q1 revenue grew but parent net profit declined about 24.82%.
2026Q1 operating cash flow and free cash flow turned negative.
Agrochemical/chemical exposure is cyclical and not a current A/B tactical theme.
core_assumptions: Agrochemical price and demand recover enough to sustain 2025 improvement.
Cash flow normalizes after Q1 working-capital pressure.
Low valuation provides downside buffer if earnings do not deteriorate.
likely_failure_points: Revenue growth fails to translate into profit and cash flow.
Safety, environmental, overseas demand, FX or trade risks intensify.

stock_risk_penalty.evidence: Penalty for 2026Q1 profit decline, negative operating cash flow, weak theme status and negative moneyflow proxy.

valuation.conclusion: Valuation odds are relatively better than high-growth themes, but earnings and cash-flow repair must be confirmed.

hold_conditions: Keep only as a small watch input while monitoring 2026 interim report.
Watch MA60 repair and moneyflow proxy improvement.
Track pesticide technical/formulation prices, inventory, receivables and safety/environmental risk.
reduce_conditions: 2026 interim report continues revenue growth with profit decline or negative operating cash flow.
Price fails near MA60 and breaks MA20 again with continued net outflow proxy.
Portfolio needs to reduce weak-theme single-stock count.
sell_invalid_conditions: Cash flow, debt, inventory or receivables deteriorate materially.
Safety/environmental, capacity, overseas demand or FX risk rises materially.

notes: No direct sell advice in this dossier.
Downstream ACTION_PLAN may use this as a hold-or-reduce input.

data_gaps: No pesticide product price tracker introduced.
Moneyflow uses Tushare raw proxy and is not equivalent to verified institutional flow.
next_update_triggers: 20-day moneyflow proxy shifts from net outflow to net inflow
Pesticide price, overseas demand, safety/environmental or major capacity disclosure
